settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationDisclaimer: This app doesn't send push or email notifications yet, so these settings are only saved for future use and have no effect right now.
settings.notifyLikeDescription: Get notified when someone likes your posts
settings.notifyCommentDescription: Get notified when someone comments on your posts
settings.commentsDescriptionMunicipality: Control whether comments are allowed on posts under your municipality's name (including your linked companies' posts).
settings.commentsDescriptionCompany: Control whether comments are allowed on reels your company has posted.
settings.dataSaverDescription: When on, reel autoplay and preloading are turned off in favor of tap-to-play (this setting only applies to this device/browser).
settings.deleteWarning: Deleting your account permanently removes all your data, including posts, likes, and comments. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmLabel: Enter your current password to confirm

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.draftNotice: This is a development draft. Have it reviewed by legal counsel before launching the service.
privacyPolicy.section1Item1: Account information (email address, name, hashed password)
privacyPolicy.section1Item2: Posted content (videos, captions, and location data uploaded by municipality/company accounts)
privacyPolicy.section1Item3: Usage history (likes, comments, view counts, etc.)
privacyPolicy.section1Item4: Login state and some display preferences stored in your browser's local storage
privacyPolicy.section2Body: We use the collected information to provide and maintain the service, improve features, and prevent misuse.
privacyPolicy.section3Body: When a post includes location data, that location may be sent to Google Maps Platform (Geocoding/Directions API) for route calculation. We do not share your personal information with third parties without consent, except where required by law.
privacyPolicy.section4Body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings. Deletion also removes related data, including posts, likes, and comments, and cannot be undone.
privacyPolicy.section5Body: For questions about this policy, please contact the service operator.
